title: nstime: add more #defines and inline some functions.
description:
Add a bunch of public defines for time unit conversion, using
calculations rather than making sure we've typed the right number of
zeroes. We should use these later, replacing cases where people have
defined their own.

Inline some of the simple conversion routines. We should probably add
additional ones, replacing cases where people have done that themselves.
